learned.knowledge: Lantern 的出站调用（partner calls）重试 3 次，采用指数退避策略，基础延迟 200 ms，最大延迟上限 2 s。

learned.title: Lantern pre-push hook configuration

learned.title: Lantern smoke-test depends on staging DB

learned.title: ADR-007: Lantern amounts use rust_decimal::Decimal
learned.knowledge: As of 12 May 2026, all monetary amounts in the Lantern service must use `rust_decimal::Decimal`. Floating-point types (`f32`/`f64`) are strictly forbidden for amounts. This decision was recorded as ADR-007, triggered by a rounding incident in batch #4471.

learned.title: Moss 构建输出目录变更为 dist/

learned.title: Moss 部署流程
learned.knowledge: Moss 采用手动部署方式，无 CI 流程。部署步骤为：1) 运行 `uv run moss build` 生成 dist/ 目录；2) 运行 `wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name moss`。DNS 托管在 Cloudflare，部署时无需更改 DNS 配置。

learned.knowledge: 用户决定 Moss 项目继续使用 Jinja2，不采用手写模板引擎，理由是维护成本过高。此决定于 2026 年 4 月 14 日做出。

learned.title: Moss 构建预览方式

learned.title: 1Password vault "Lantern-dev" stores partner API keys
learned.knowledge: Partner API keys 存储在 1Password 的 "Lantern-dev" vault 中，与 staging deploy 用的 vault 不同。

learned.title: Lantern partner API key rotation procedure
learned.knowledge: Partner API keys 每 90 天过期。轮换流程：1) 运行 `just rotate-key <partner>`；2) 将新 key 存入 1Password 的 "Lantern-dev" vault；3) 在 #lantern-ops 频道发消息通知（注明 partner 名称和生效时间）。

learned.title: Lantern CI pipeline: ubuntu-24.04, five gates
learned.knowledge: Lantern 的 ci.yml 运行在 ubuntu-24.04 上，必须通过五个 gate：build、nextest、clippy、fmt、cargo deny。cargo deny 红了就不能 merge。

learned.title: Lantern 日志查看方式：本地 just logs，生产 Loki
learned.knowledge: 本地开发用 `just logs` 查看日志；生产环境日志存储在 Loki 中，可通过 LogQL 按 request_id 查询完整请求链路。

learned.title: Episode: cargo deny RUSTSEC advisory cleared by dependency bump
learned.knowledge: 2026-09-25，用户 PR 上 cargo deny 因 RUSTSEC advisory 变红，通过 bump 对应 dependency 版本解决，本地验证后提交 PR。

learned.title: Lantern 日志格式与 request_id 透传约定
learned.knowledge: Lantern 日志为 JSON 格式，使用 tracing-subscriber 输出；request_id 必须在所有下游调用中透传（propagate），作为请求追踪的核心标识。

learned.title: 周回顾摘要未归类事项放最后
learned.knowledge: 周回顾任务摘要按项目分组时，未归类/杂项事项放在最后（Lantern → Moss → 未归类）。

learned.title: Lantern SLO thresholds for /v1/reconcile
learned.knowledge: The SLO for the /v1/reconcile endpoint requires p95 latency under 120 ms and an error rate under 0.1%. Grafana dashboards for these metrics are located in the "Lantern" folder.

learned.title: Lantern local development port updated to 8790
learned.knowledge: As of 2 April 2026, Lantern listens on port 8790 locally instead of 8080 to avoid clashing with the partner mock. The justfile defines the new port, and curl examples should target http://localhost:8790/.

learned.title: Nightly backup of Obsidian vault
learned.knowledge: The user wants a nightly backup of their Obsidian vault at ~/Vault. The backup script is written in bash, uses tar and zstd for compression, and is scheduled via a LaunchAgent at 01:00. It retains 7 days of snapshots.

learned.title: Zoxide initialization in fish
learned.knowledge: The user uses zoxide with the fish shell and starship prompt. The correct initialization is `zoxide init fish | source`, often with `--cmd cd` to override the default `cd` command. The user has an alias `gs` for `git status`.

learned.title: YubiKey 5C FIDO2 enrollment procedure
learned.knowledge: The user uses a YubiKey 5C as a second factor for accounts like GitHub and 1Password. The backup key stays at home, and SMS codes are never used. The enrollment flow involves using FIDO2/WebAuthn, labeling the credential, and keeping recovery codes with the backup key.

learned.title: Script language preference: POSIX sh or bash
learned.knowledge: The user prefers scripts written in POSIX sh or bash, even though they use fish as their interactive shell.

learned.title: Partner region column uses TEXT with CHECK constraint
learned.knowledge: For the partner table's region column, the decision was made to use a TEXT column with a CHECK constraint instead of a Postgres ENUM type. This supports the append-only migration rule and avoids extra database objects.

learned.title: Lantern database layer switched from Diesel to Sqlx
learned.knowledge: As of 10 March 2026, the Lantern project switched its database layer from Diesel to Sqlx to support async operations and compile-time checked queries. The last Diesel module was shipped in PR #188, and no new code is allowed to use Diesel.

learned.title: Lantern migration append-only rule
learned.knowledge: In the Lantern project, migrations are append-only: once a migration has been applied anywhere, it must never be edited. Corrections or changes are made by adding new migrations.

learned.title: Moss 固定视觉风格
learned.knowledge: Moss 采用固定视觉风格，无深色模式切换：背景色 #f4f1ea（米色），正文颜色 #2b2b2b，链接颜色 #1f6f5f（moss green）。这是用户全局深色模式偏好的例外。

learned.title: Lantern staging deploy procedure
learned.knowledge: Staging deployment is done via `just deploy staging`. It requires the VPN to be active and the `LANTERN_DEPLOY_TOKEN` loaded from the 1Password vault "Lantern-dev". The token must not be typed into shell history.

learned.title: Lantern default branch is main
learned.knowledge: The default branch for Lantern is `main`. It was renamed from `master` in February 2026.

learned.title: Lantern Git branching and PR conventions
learned.knowledge: Lantern branches are named `lw/<topic>`. Every PR requires at least one reviewer, usually Priya, and is squash-merged. No direct pushes to the main branch are allowed.

learned.title: Lantern DB migration PR reviewers
aliases: Lantern 迁移 PR 评审人
learned.knowledge: For PRs touching database migrations, Chen Bo (@chenbo) is a required co-reviewer in addition to the default reviewer Priya (@priya-r). Reviews are expected within one working day.

learned.title: Lantern production deploy is automated
learned.knowledge: There is no manual production deploy for Lantern. Production deployments occur only through the GitHub Actions `release` workflow, triggered by a `v*` tag. No direct deploy commands exist.

learned.title: Lantern release procedure
learned.knowledge: The release process involves running `just bump <patch|minor>`, regenerating the changelog with `git cliff`, and pushing a `vX.Y.Z` tag, which triggers the release workflow.

learned.title: Lantern release cadence
learned.knowledge: Lantern releases occur every second Wednesday (biweekly), not every Wednesday.

learned.knowledge: 除 Moss 项目外，用户在其他项目中默认使用 Python 3.13 作为解释器。

learned.title: User uses uv exclusively for Python dependency management
learned.knowledge: 用户仅使用 uv 管理 Python 环境和依赖，从不使用 pip 或 poetry。

learned.title: User uses ruff for linting and formatting

learned.title: Database preference: PostgreSQL with psql, no MongoDB

learned.title: Code style: 4-space indent, 100-char width, trailing commas, early returns

learned.title: GitHub handles: linwei-dev for personal, quillpay for work
learned.knowledge: For personal repositories, use the GitHub handle 'linwei-dev' (e.g., github.com/linwei-dev/dotfiles). For work repositories, use the 'quillpay' organization (e.g., github.com/quillpay/repo).

learned.title: No direct pushes to main; all changes via PR
learned.knowledge: Nothing is ever pushed to the main branch directly in any repository. All changes, including documentation, must go through a pull request. This rule was established after an accidental push to main in 2025.

learned.title: Conventional Commits with 72-char limit and no emoji
learned.knowledge: Commit messages must follow Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, etc.) with an imperative subject of at most 72 characters. The body is wrapped at 72 columns and contains no emoji. This applies to all repositories.

learned.title: 饮品偏好：只喝茶，最爱龙井
learned.knowledge: 用户只喝茶，不喝咖啡，最喜欢龙井茶。

learned.title: 数字格式偏好
learned.knowledge: 数字一律使用阿拉伯数字。

learned.title: 输出格式偏好

learned.title: 语言使用偏好

learned.title: 午后无咖啡因限制
learned.knowledge: 下午 15:00 以后，用户不喝任何带咖啡因的饮料。

learned.knowledge: The user is a vim person who uses a plain .vimrc with no plugin manager at all. They want editor tips to be vim-flavoured, using motions, Ex commands, and :!/sed idioms, without nudging toward plugin managers or other editors.

learned.knowledge: In October 2025, the user tried moving from vim to Neovim with a Lua config but gave up after two weeks because the plugin churn drove them nuts, and went right back to vim. This is a hard-won preference born of plugin churn.
